name: THUMOS
description: A challenge and dataset for action recognition and temporal detection in untrimmed, in-the-wild video footage.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) at temporal IoU thresholds
notes: Non-LLM computer-vision benchmark focused on untrimmed video temporal localization; evaluation relies on temporal IoU thresholds and mAP. Dataset is relatively small by modern standards; possible (but limited) pretraining contamination for models trained on large video corpora.
